about: Pashto narration for The Bee and the Elephant, laid over the pages and pictures of the English Curious Reader book. Page numbers are body indexes of the converted English book (0 = title page). Text is taken from the sentence recordings' file names; pages 1 and 8 were completed from the word clips (file names cut short) and need checking by a Pashto reader. 'link' lists the Pashto words that trigger the page's picture (replacing the English glow hotspots).
